_comment: Phase 9c walking-skeleton scenario: proves the encounter-sim splice end-to-end (design_captain_missions.md Sec 13.A.1's 5 concretising points) -- Poisson-scheduled ambient traffic spliced into the EXISTING live encounter-sim (app.oracle_planner.plan() as the deterministic OOW, Sec 13.C.15), while the mission-sim's own clock/fuel keep advancing. No brown envelopes in this scenario -- kept focused on the splice mechanism alone; a combined ambient+brown-envelope scenario is a natural future extension, not needed to prove this mechanism. Same fictional stub_corridor_v1 region as the other skeleton scenarios, not for navigation use.

mission_order.goal: Deliver cargo from the corridor's southern waypoint to its northern waypoint
success_criteria: arrive within the stated ETA deadline
